description: Moderately complex prompts requiring deeper analysis and structured responses

prompts.title: Compare and Contrast
prompts.prompt: Compare and contrast [topic A] and [topic B]. List at least 3 similarities and 3 differences.

prompts.title: Pros and Cons Analysis
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive pros and cons list for [decision/choice]. Include at least 5 points for each side.

prompts.title: Step-by-Step Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed step-by-step guide on how to [task]. Include tips and warnings for each step.

prompts.title: Email with Context
prompts.prompt: Write a professional email to [recipient] regarding [situation]. The tone should be [formal/friendly/apologetic]. Context: [additional details]

prompts.title: Problem Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following problem and provide a structured solution: [problem description]. Break down the problem, identify root causes, and suggest actionable solutions.

prompts.title: Meeting Summary
prompts.prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes into key points, action items, and decisions made: [meeting notes]

prompts.title: Research Summary
prompts.prompt: Provide a comprehensive summary of [topic] including: background information, current state, key stakeholders, and future trends.

prompts.title: Feedback Structure
prompts.prompt: Give constructive feedback on the following work: [content]. Use the sandwich method: start with positives, provide specific improvement suggestions, and end with encouragement.

prompts.title: Case Study Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following case study: [case description]. Identify the main challenges, evaluate the decisions made, and suggest alternative approaches.

prompts.title: Learning Path
prompts.prompt: Create a learning path for mastering [skill/topic]. Include: prerequisites, recommended resources, practice exercises, and milestones for tracking progress.

prompts.title: SWOT Analysis
prompts.prompt: Conduct a SWOT analysis for [project/business/idea]. Provide at least 3 points for each category: Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats.

prompts.title: Content Outline
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed outline for an article/blog post about [topic]. Include main sections, subsections, and key points to cover in each.

prompts.title: Interview Questions
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 interview questions for a [job title] position. Include a mix of technical, behavioral, and situational questions.

prompts.title: Product Description
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling product description for [product name]. Include: key features, benefits, target audience, and a call to action.

prompts.title: FAQ Generation
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive FAQ section for [product/service]. Include at least 10 common questions with detailed answers.
